entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 747, Standbuch 1011, Folio: 85v, Schreiber: xxx
entries.german: Anno 1542 Montags pg Letare verschrieben sich die gemaind zu Baldershaim gegen Jorgen von Leutzenbron vnd Julianen von Rosenberg seiner hausfrawen fur 2000 F hauptsumma vnd järlichen 100 F zinß; 2° conract. konr. fol. 126. [Einfügung am Rand: Vide Leutzenbron tom 2 fol. 50.]
entries.english: In 1542, on Monday after Laetare Sunday, the community of Baldersheim bound itself to Georg von Leutzenbronn and Juliane von Rosenberg, his wife, for a principal sum of 2,000 florins and annual interest of 100 florins. Second register of Conrad’s contracts, fol. 126. Marginal insertion: see Leutzenbronn, volume 2, fol. 50.

facts.content: was named with her husband Georg von Leutzenbronn as a creditor under a bond from the community of Baldersheim for a principal sum and annual interest.
